fix: Load the JWT signing secret from an environment variable or secret manager and rotate the exposed value.
Use a parameterized query such as LIKE $1 with the value '%' + q + '%' passed in the params array.
Reduce the name with path.basename (or resolve and verify the result stays inside REPORT_DIR) before calling sendFile.
Hash passwords with a salted adaptive algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of unsalted MD5.
Validate the URL against an allow-list of hosts and block private, loopback and link-local addresses before fetching.
Require requireAdmin or verify that the ticket belongs to req.user before deleting it.
Use execFile with an argument array and validate req.body.format against an allow-list instead of interpolating into a shell string.
